Manifest.Name: File Memory
Manifest.Description: Keeps facts on this device and supplies matching ones to prompt actions
Action.Name: Remember in File Memory
Action.Empty: Nothing to remember: the text is empty.
Collection.Label: Memories
Collection.Description: Facts kept on this device, one fact or topic per entry. Prompt actions recall up to five matching entries when memory is on in Advanced settings or a profile selects File Memory. To save text from a prompt action, set its action target to "Remember in File Memory".
Collection.DisabledDescription: Enable File Memory to view and edit its memories.
Collection.ContentPlaceholder: For example: Project Aurora uses British English.
Memory.TooLong: A memory can be at most {0} characters.
Memory.Duplicate: Two memories have the same text. Remove or change one of them.
